visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy wearing a straw hat with a red ribbon plays with a toy in a bright living room. A man in sunglasses appears on a train, and the scene shifts to an exterior shot of the National Taiwan Science Education Center building surrounded by summer greenery. (2) Inside a colorful exhibition, children look at shadow projections. The boy interacts with a tablet on a stand, scanning his face as a digital pink interface tracks his eyes. He stands in a hallway decorated with vibrant cartoon storefront graphics. (3) The boy explores a play area featuring green turf, wooden structures, and soft cushions. He crawls through a tunnel and rolls a large, clear inflatable ring across the artificial grass. Adults and other children are visible in the background under bright indoor lights. (4) In an immersive room with purple and blue neon projections, children interact with graphics of mushrooms and instruments. A woman in a pink tiger costume leads the kids in a group activity. The boy sits on the floor watching carefully. (5) Children sit at wooden tables drawing with colored pencils. The boy presents a drawing of a character on a pink card. He later uses a green interactive megaphone device and eats small shaped pastries before posing for a photo booth machine.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly adult male narrator starts with a warm, energetic tone accompanied by upbeat acoustic BGM with piano and light percussion. The audio is a clean field recording with minimal indoor room tone. (2) Faint background chatter and the sounds of children laughing become audible as the scene shifts to the museum. High-pitched digital 'ping' sound effects punctuate the narrative when visual interactive elements are shown. (3) During the immersive forest scene, synthesized instrument textures blend into the BGM, creating a magical atmosphere. The narrator maintains a steady conversational pace. (4) In the final phase, the voice of a young child speaking in Traditional Chinese is heard clearly, exhibiting high vocal arousal and positive valence. The BGM concludes with a soft harmonic resolution and fades to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and promote a family visit to the 'WhooGuPo and Friends' exhibition at the National Taiwan Science Education Center. The video uses the narrator's enthusiastic account and his son's joy to showcase the exhibition's interactive AR and immersive features to other parents.
